meta.name: pi-goal
meta.description: Persistent Codex-style goal tracking for pi. Use when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手持续跟踪长期目标，可随时查看和调整进度。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望让AI助手记住并持续推进你的长期目标。
copy.tagline_en: Keep your assistant on track with long-term goals, pause or resume anytime.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to remember and keep working on multi-step goals.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为长期目标创建、查看和更新记录；在标记目标完成前，它会核对实际交付物与证据，存在不确定或未完成项时不会标记完成。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求设置、继续或审计长期目标等时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置一个长期目标：完成核心模块开发。
say.note: Claude 会创建一条目标记录，并开始跟踪进度。

say.text: 查看当前目标的进展怎么样？
say.note: Claude 会读取目标并汇报当前状态。

say.text: 使用 /goal pause 暂停当前目标。
say.note: 该命令控制暂停状态转换。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will create, view, and update records for long-running goals. Before marking a goal complete, it audits actual deliverables and evidence, and will not mark complete while required work or uncertainty remains.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal.

say_en.text: Create a long-term goal: ship the core module.
say_en.note: Claude will create a goal record and start tracking.

say_en.text: Show me the current progress of my goal.
say_en.note: Claude reads the goal and reports status.

say_en.text: Use /goal pause to pause the current goal.
say_en.note: The command controls the pause transition.
